title: Senior Technical Account Manager (AMER)
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



We're hiring a Senior Technical Account Manager who has already done this job at a SaaS company: someone who has led complex implementations and owned enterprise relationships for the long haul, and who builds with AI rather than just using it.

 

TAMs at ClickUp are the long-term technical and strategic partner for a portfolio of enterprise customers. This isn't a relationship-only CSM role, and it's not an implementation role where you get buried in requests and lose the account strategy. You'll discover the business problem, build and implement the right solution, drive adoption, and prove the business impact, staying with your customers from first rollout through renewal and expansion, turning delivered value into a credible growth story.

 

What you'll do

 

Own your customers for the long term

 - Be the strategic and technical owner of a portfolio of enterprise accounts, from first rollout through renewal and expansion.

 - Build and grow champions across admins, operators, and executive stakeholders.

 - Monitor adoption, account health, and stakeholder engagement; spot risk early and build recovery or acceleration plans.

 - Run executive business reviews with a clear point of view on delivered business value, progress, opportunities, and priorities.

 - Drive renewal strategy with your account team and bring the commercial instincts to spot expansion signals and turn outcomes into strong value stories.

 

Design and deliver the solution

 - Lead discovery that maps current-state vs. future-state workflows (Intake → Execution → Reporting).

 - Lead complex implementations end to end: governance, architecture, process design, and rollout across multiple teams or business units.

 - Recover momentum when projects stall, priorities shift, or stakeholder alignment breaks down.

 - Know when to standardize, when to keep flexibility, and how to balance technical ambition with customer readiness.

 

Build with AI

 - Design, build, and scale ClickUp AI agents, automations, and workflows tied to real customer KPIs.

 - Advise customers on prompt design, agent architecture, and scaling AI use cases across teams.

 - Track AI usage and consumption against plan, and turn usage insight into new opportunities.

 

Drive adoption and change

 - Make adoption your mandate, not a milestone. Pair every solution with a structured enablement and change management plan so new ways of working actually take hold across teams rather than stopping with the project sponsor.

 - Define success measures and adoption milestones with your stakeholders before go-live, track them relentlessly, and course-correct early when usage signals turn negative.

 - Build a culture of adoption inside your accounts: champion networks, internal advocates, and team-level habits that keep ClickUp and AI central to how they work, not a tool they drift away from.

 - Treat low adoption as a commercial signal: a customer who isn't using the product is a customer who won't renew. Intervene before it becomes a renewal conversation.

 

Partner across ClickUp

 - Be the voice of the customer for Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support.

 - Keep ownership even when multiple teams are involved.

 

What we're looking for

 

Required

 - 5+ years in a customer-facing, post-sale SaaS role (Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or similar).

 - Direct experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations end to end, with multiple stakeholders.

 - A track record of owning long-term enterprise customer relationships and building champions.

 - Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows, agents, or automations in a business context.

 - Executive presence: confident with both hands-on operators and C-level stakeholders.

 - Strong judgment in ambiguity; you simplify complexity and keep momentum through change.

 

Preferred

 - Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday.com http://Monday.com, Smartsheet, Wrike, Jira, or a comparable work-management platform.

 - Hands-on experience with agentic tools such as Claude, n8n, Make, Zapier, or LangChain.

 - Technical aptitude with integrations, APIs, automation logic, and data modeling.

 - Experience carrying a renewal or expansion number (GRR, NRR).

 

What sets you apart

 - You've built something with AI that a team actually runs on, and you can walk us through how it works.

 - You think in workflows and systems, not just relationships.

 - You've run enterprise implementations and know change management firsthand.

 - You stay with customers long after go-live, and they want you there.

Equal Opportunity Employer 

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

title: Implementation Manager - Enterprise
description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation !
 More about our team and company: 
 Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg 
 Our careers page:  https://www.fleetio.com/careers 
 Fleetio’s largest customers don’t need a standard onboarding checklist; they need a trusted partner who can make a complex change feel manageable. As an Implementation Manager, you’ll lead a focused portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers through launches that can span teams, locations, data, and connected systems. You’ll shape the plan with customer leaders, help teams make sound rollout decisions, and see the impact as Fleetio becomes part of how their operations run. You’ll also help strengthen the way Fleetio delivers its most complex implementations.
 This is a senior, customer-facing individual-contributor role. You’ll lead through project ownership and influence, partnering with customer executives and operators and with Fleetio teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.
 What You’ll Do
 Lead a focused portfolio of complex Enterprise implementations from post-sale handoff through launch and stabilization. Build a trusted partnership, understand what success means in the customer’s operation, and shape a rollout plan that fits the real-world need, not just the software setup.
 Bring the moving parts together. Turn discovery into a clear path forward, coordinating customer and Fleetio owners across workflows, data, configuration, integrations, testing, and rollout. Keep scope, responsibilities, and dependencies clear and documented, and bring in technical partners where needed.
 Make complexity manageable. Use pilots, phased rollouts, and readiness checkpoints to reduce risk; keep customer project leads and executives aligned; and surface risks or changed assumptions early with a practical recommendation.
 Set customers up to sustain the change. Make role-based training and adoption part of the plan, lead a thoughtful transition to Customer Success, and turn lessons from complex launches into better ways of working across Fleetio.
 Your Experience
 5+ years in customer-facing SaaS implementation, enterprise onboarding, technical project delivery, or a related role, with direct ownership of complex implementations through launch.
 Experience guiding enterprise customers through multi-stakeholder, multi-location, or work-stream deployments.
 Strong project leadership: you can turn customer goals into a workable plan, coordinate parallel work-streams and dependencies, and reset expectations when conditions change.
 Clear, confident communication with customer operators, IT teams, project leads, and executives, including leading discovery, facilitating decisions, and navigating difficult conversations.
 Technical aptitude with data-heavy implementations, including migration, configuration, integrations, testing, and cutover. You know when to involve technical specialists and how to keep customer expectations grounded in confirmed scope.
 A consultative, detail-oriented approach to change management and adoption, with the judgment to manage risk and competing priorities while keeping customers moving toward sustainable use.
 Helpful Experience
 Experience implementing software for customers in fleet management, transportation, logistics, or field service.
 Familiarity with how fleet teams use maintenance, telematics, fuel, or ERP systems in their day-to-day operations.
 Role Considerations
 15% Travel required to customer on-site workshops and internal meetings
 Some flexibility in working hours may be needed to coordinate with customer teams across time zones.
 Benefits 
 Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
 Vision insurance
 Incentive stock options
 401(k) match of 4%
 PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
 Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
 FSA & HSA options
 Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
 Community service funds
 Professional development funds
 Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
 Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
 Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
 Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
 Remote working friendly since 2012 #LI-Remote
 Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. 
 This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will. 
 If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

title: Senior Partner Account Manager, ISV
salary_text: $202K – $308K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission • Multiple Ranges
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Embedded partnerships put Ramp inside the software our customers already use to run their businesses. Partners host the Ramp application, manage budgets and limits in their own UI, and trigger payments inside their own workflows. Our first partners are live or launching now, and the job from here is to activate their customers at scale.

As our first Embedded Partner Account Manager, you'll own our signed partners from signature onward and carry their activation number. ISV Account Executives sign new partners and hand them to you with a 24-month activation forecast you've co-signed. From there, you run the relationship, the activation plan, and the joint go-to-market.

You'll work with our Technical Partner Manager, Partner Consulting, Growth, Sales, and CX. They own integration design, bank approvals, customer onboarding, and technical support, so your time goes to activation. Most customers will activate inside the partner's product without talking to Ramp, so you'll make that funnel convert and work the accounts that get stuck.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agree on the number, then own the partner - co-sign the 24-month activation forecast before signature, take the handoff from the ISV AE, and run the kickoff with our Technical Partner Manager. From there, you're the partner's day-to-day and executive contact.

 - Run the partner cadence - weekly during launch, monthly once live, and a quarterly business review on activation vs forecast. Keep one joint action plan with a Ramp owner, a partner owner and a date on every row, and escalate when dates slip.

 - Own each partner's activation plan - based on the motion (product-led, sales-led, or migration) and set funnel targets from the forecast model. Build the joint marketing calendar with Growth, from co-branded campaigns and webinars to event follow-up. Audit every place Ramp shows up in the partner's product, and get the customer lists and account mapping our campaigns need.

 - Enable both sales teams - run seller kickoffs and keep battlecards, FAQs, and pricing guidance up to date in the partner's sales hub. Give our AEs a partner demo account and the integration story. Make sure every rep on both sides knows the customer offer and their incentive.

 - Run joint selling and work the exceptions - review shared pipeline with the partner's sales team weekly, and pair Ramp and partner reps on strategic accounts. Keep one deal channel where our AEs and theirs coordinate every shared deal. Work stuck applications, approved-but-not-onboarded accounts, and priority customers, routing sales-led deals to Ramp AEs and self-serve wins to CS.

 - Report the number every week - activated customers and contribution profit vs forecast, by partner and by motion. Show where the funnel stalls between lead and activation, with the blocker and its owner. Keep attribution clean so partner credit and rev share are right.

 - Grow the partnership - own amendments, renewals, and new products inside each agreement, including rev share and attribution terms. Bring in Partner Consulting for any new build.

 - Write the playbook - turn what works with our first partners into the activation kit, enablement and launch checklist every new partner starts with. Automate repetitive work so each new partner takes less of your time.


WHAT YOU NEED

 - 4+ years in account management, partner management, customer success or B2B sales.

 - You've grown a book you inherited, not just closed new logos - adoption, activation or expansion against a quota.

 - Fluency with funnels and data. You can read a cohort, find where customers stall, and pull your own numbers from Salesforce and dashboards.

 - You can run a relationship with a partner's executives and their product, sales, and marketing leads simultaneously, and hold both sides to their dates.

 - Comfort with APIs and integrated products. You don't write code, but you can walk a customer's path through a partner's product and tell a product gap from a process gap.

 - Clear, structured writing. Your weekly update tells a partner exec what moved, what's stuck and what you need from them.

 - You've carried a number while building the process around it. The playbooks, dashboards and handoffs for this motion are still being written, and you'll write a lot of them.

 - You use AI every day to research accounts, build reports and draft enablement.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience in embedded finance, payments, card programs or fintech partnerships

 - Experience managing ISV, platform or channel partners

 - Experience growing a self-serve funnel inside a partner's product, such as in-product placements, marketplace listings or partner-hosted sign-up

 - Experience enabling a partner's sales team or launching a product through a partner

 - Experience negotiating amendments, rev share or partner incentives

 - Familiarity with Salesforce, Crossbeam and Gong






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Role Overview 
 This is not a conventional Customer Success Role. The Customer Success Manager is the business outcome-oriented post-sale owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers. The role is responsible for identifying opportunities for cross-sell and up-sell to better protect customers. The ideal CSM is inquisitive, with a consulting mindset for partnering with and helping build valuable outcomes for customers.
 Why this role matters 
DTEX customers rely on our platform to address complex insider risk, AI risk management, and data protection challenges. The Customer Success Manager is the trusted advisor to a portfolio of enterprise customers. This is not a reactive account management role. You make sure customers get measurable value from DTEX and stay ahead of risks to that value.
You will turn DTEX capability into business outcomes, drive platform adoption, and secure long-term renewal readiness while identifying expansion opportunities. The ideal CSM is inquisitive and brings a consulting mindset to every customer partnership . 
 Core Accountabilities 
 Own outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise customers, with accountability for retention, adoption, customer health, and renewals. When an issue affects a customer, take responsibility for driving it forward, involve the right people, and follow it through to completion.
 Lead the customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal, using established success planning, operating cadence, and health management practices.
 Help customers improve their security posture and reduce insider risk exposure by aligning DTEX capabilities to their priorities, tracking program milestones, and independently delivering formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
 Build multithreaded relationships across Security, IT, Legal, HR, Fraud, Procurement, and executive stakeholders, engaging confidently with both executives and operational teams.
 Own customer-side renewal readiness through value evidence, health tracking, stakeholder alignment, forecast accuracy, and recovery planning for at-risk accounts. Identify where additional DTEX capabilities would better protect the customer, and partner with Sales to progress them.
 Lead customer communication during escalations. Keep stakeholders informed and bring in leadership and technical teams at the right time with clear context and a recommended next step.
 Run structured internal account syncs across Sales, Technical Success, Support, Engineering, Product, Services, and Intelligence and Investigations Services. Work as part of the wider account team, share what you learn, and make sure agreed actions have a clear owner and due date.
 Maintain accurate customer scorecards, success plans, stakeholder maps, health signals, renewal forecasts, risks, value evidence, and next steps in customer success and CRM systems.
 Technical and Enterprise Insider Risk Expectations 
Engage credibly on insider risk, user behavior, data protection, security operations, privacy, and compliance, and guide customers at varying levels of program maturity. This role does not replace implementation, Support, Solution Architecture, or Technical Success specialists. You will recognize risk, ask informed questions, bring in the right expertise, and translate technical conditions into customer and business impact. We expect a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning in the insider risk landscape. You will use approved AI tools to automate routine work and improve research, planning, and risk identification, while validating accuracy and protecting sensitive information.
 Level Scope 
Independently owns a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts as an individual contributor. You will operate with autonomy in daily execution, apply established Customer Success practices and playbooks, coordinate defined account workstreams, and share practical knowledge across the business. Strategic, commercial, or technical risks are raised early with clear recommendations, with guidance from Customer Success leadership on complex commercial or executive matters. As our Customer Success function continues to scale and mature, you will be expected to operate effectively within ambiguity and contribute to the refinement of the function.
 Success in this role 
 Customers achieve measurable adoption and value outcomes.
 Renewal readiness and forecasts are evidence-based and current.
 Risks are identified early and managed through accountable follow-through.
 Internal escalations and cross-functional collaborations are handled constructively, with clear ownership and agreed outcomes.
 You act as a structured Voice of the Customer (VoC) to inform product development and proactively contribute to the team’s knowledge-sharing and development.
 QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS 
 Technical & Experience Baselines: 
 4 or more years of relevant customer-facing experience in enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, consulting, implementation, insider risk program management, or Customer Success.
 Demonstrated ownership of enterprise customer relationships, measurable outcomes, renewals, escalations, and cross-functional delivery.
 Working knowledge of security operations, insider risk, data protection, enterprise deployment concepts, integrations, privacy, or compliance.
 Strong written and verbal communication, program coordination, sound judgment, and the ability to drive accountability through influence.
 Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent enterprise technology, cybersecurity, consulting, military, intelligence, or customer-leadership experience.
 Behavioral Competencies: 
 A consulting mindset which identifies the business driver behind a request and solves the real problem.
 Able to explain technical items in business terms that executives can act on.
 Emotional intelligence with a track record of maintaining composure and driving alignment in high-pressure customer environments.
 A strong sense of ownership and a proven ability to work co

title: Scaled Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro , empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.
At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
 AI Fearlessly.
 Position Summary: 
 This is a new role in the Global Customer Success Organisation at TrendAI. The traditional Customer Success Manager model is being rewritten for the AI economy. As part of the Scaled Customer Success team, you operate an AI-powered engagement system that gives thousands of our customers the proactive support they have never had before, with a clear focus on driving adoption at scale so they achieve their business outcomes with TrendAI Vision One™. 
 The Scaled Customer Success Manager owns adoption and customer outcomes across the customer lifecycle for a large book of business of Volume Enterprise customers, by directing a team of AI agents and acting as the Human in the Loop (HITL). You do not manage accounts one check-in at a time. You design, supervise and improve the agent-led motion, read portfolio data to spot adoption patterns and risks, and tell customers what to do next, not just how things are going. When an account needs a trusted advisor, you are that advisor. 
 This role sits within the Global Customer Success Organisation and works closely with the wider CS Organisation, CSTAs, Retention Managers, CS Operations, and the Global Trend IQ team, who build and maintain the virtual CSM platform. Together, you drive customer outcomes and positively impact GRR and NRR across the customer portfolio. 
 Work Location: Austin | Dallas | Remote
 What You’ll Do: 
 Triage the daily agent escalation queue and your book of business by adoption health, risk and urgency, using dashboards and agent summaries to prioritise attention. 
 Review, edit and approve AI-drafted customer communications, verifying alert details, risk scores and product references for accuracy, tone and brand alignment. 
 Monitor agent confidence scores, adoption campaign performance and escalation patterns, flagging systemic issues to CS Operations and Global IQ Engineering. 
 Engage directly with customers on escalations where the agent-led motion isn’t enough, taking over complex, technical or sensitive conversations, guiding mitigation of TrendAI Vision One™ security alerts, and handling escalations through the Global Risk Process, with Support, Product and leadership as needed. 
 Drive adoption at scale across your book of business: resolve onboarding blockers and missed adoption milestones, and turn consumption and adoption data into prescriptive recommendations that move customers through the adoption lifecycle and protect GRR. 
 Qualify expansion signals from adoption and consumption data and hand them to Account Managers and Account Executives with a clear business case. 
 Give structured feedback on AI drafts, set agent plays, triggers and guardrails, and log defects to continuously improve agent performance and the scaled CS playbook. 
 Share the voice of the customer with Product, Support and Marketing, and work with CS Managers and the Global Trend IQ team to align escalation thresholds, engagement standards and platform improvements. 
 Report on book-of-business adoption, GRR, NRR and Vision One™ adoption metrics within the CS operating model cadence, including quarterly business reviews. 
 Coordinate with Services (MDR, IR and Professional Services) on retainer and consumption tracking, in line with the agreed RACI for shared customer engagements.
 What You Should Have: 
 Required:
 AI fluency: Experience reviewing or quality-checking AI-generated content and ability to use AI tools and insights to personalise customer engagement, predict churn and recommend next-best actions 
 3+ years in customer success, services or support within enterprise software or cybersecurity, with a track record of driving adoption and customer outcomes 
 Solid technical foundation, preferably in cybersecurity and security concepts (EDR/XDR/NDR). 
 Comfortable with consumption and value metrics, and ability to read usage data and dashboards to make data-backed recommendations for adoption and expansion motions 
 Experience with customer success platforms, CRM and collaboration tools 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
 Ability to work well under pressure, both independently and in a team 
 Fluent written and spoken English, plus a market language where needed (French, German, Swedish or Spanish)
 Preferred:
 Built for scale: You manage a high-throughput queue across a large book of business while keeping a close eye on the detail of each individual account. 
 Quality-minded: You review AI-generated content critically, catching errors in tone, accuracy and relevance before they reach a customer. 
 A clear, professional communicator: When you step into a customer conversation, you build credibility and trust. 
 Curious about AI: You don’t need to be an engineer, but you’re interested in how AI tools work and how to make them better. 
 Process-driven: You follow established workflows, log outcomes diligently and speak up when something isn’t working. 
 Comfortable with ambiguity: This is a new role with evolving processes, and you’re at ease with things not being fully defined from day one. 
 Customer-centric: You keep a real person in mind with every email you approve, and you are comfortable hosting customer calls, webinars and live conversations. 
 Bonus Qualifications:
 Familiarity with TrendAI products, especially Vision One™ 
 Experience with AI tools, prompt engineering, or working alongside automated systems

title: Senior Sales Enablement Manager/Onboarding Lead
description:

A key part of your mandate is ownership of global sales onboarding for Account Executives. You will shape the onboarding strategy and experience, own and evolve the content and learning journey, and ensure new sellers have the knowledge, skills and resources they need to become productive quickly. You will define and track measures such as readiness and time-to-ramp, using data and feedback to continuously improve the onboarding experience and its business impact. This is a role where strategy meets execution. You bring project management expertise, structured problem-solving, and clear communication to programes that directly influence seller performance and customer outcomes. From planning through execution, you ensure initiatives are well-defined, flawlessly delivered, and continuously improved to support critical business priorities.
 A Typical Day in the Life Includes:
 Lead enablement programs that align with strategy and strengthen our global sales capabilities.
 Apply project and change management best practices to ensure consistency, quality and impact.
 Partner with sales leaders and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 Collaborate across Sales, GTM, L&D, HR, Operations and Technology to drive adoption of new systems, processes and ways of working.
 Own the global sales onboarding program for Account Executives, setting the strategy, standards and experience from new-hire induction through to role readiness.
 Own and continuously evolve onboarding content, learning journeys and supporting resources, ensuring they reflect current sales strategy, processes, methodologies and tools.
 Partner with sales leaders and regional stakeholders to deliver a consistent global onboarding experience while addressing relevant regional needs.
 Define, track and improve onboarding success measures, including time-to-ramp, readiness, program completion and other indicators of seller productivity.
 Reinforce adoption of value-selling and MEDDPICC methodologies across the sales organization.
 Basic Qualifications:
 Program or project management experience, ideally in technology or SaaS.
 Experience working in sales enablement or program development.
 Consulting experience.
 Communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting to a range of audiences.
 Legal authorization to work permanently in the United States for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.
 Preferred Qualifications:
 Experience working in a software or technology company.
 Experience working across an organisation to develop sales training programmes.
 Experience designing, managing or scaling sales onboarding programs across multiple regions or geographies.
 US Remote (Atlanta, GA and Dallas, TX)

title: Director, Americas Renewals
description:
Riverbed. Empower the Experience
 Riverbed, the leader in AIOps for observability, helps organizations optimize their users’ experiences by leveraging AI automation for the prevention, identification, and resolution of IT issues. With over 20 years of experience in data collection and AI and machine learning, Riverbed’s open and AI-powered observability platform and solutions optimize digital experiences and greatly improve IT efficiency. Riverbed also offers industry-leading Acceleration solutions that provide fast, agile, secure acceleration of any app, over any network, to users anywhere. Together with our thousands of market-leading customers globally – including 95% of the FORTUNE 100 – we are empowering next-generation digital experiences. Learn more at riverbed .com 
 Position
 Title: Director, Americas Renewals
 Location: Home/ Remote ( Some travel required)
 Riverbed is seeking a dynamic Renewals Sales leader who deeply understands the renewals business and has a proven track record of strong operational command. This leader must have a history of driving renewal revenue, exceeding renewal revenue targets, and meeting retention rate goals for their team, while bringing disciplined forecasting, process rigor, and execution excellence. 
 What you will do
 Create strategy and oversee daily execution of the Americas Renewals teams in partnership with Americas senior sales leadership, with securing multi-year renewals as an essential part of the strategy. 
 Achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly and annual renewal targets by securing renewals on time or before contract expiration, and give senior management an accurate forecast and risk analysis of all assigned accounts. 
 Define programs to identify, address and mitigate risk to on-time renewals, including operationalizing a renewals readiness assessment process for contracts expiring 2-4 quarters out. 
 Closely monitor at-risk accounts and work with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Channel and Professional Services leadership to resolve customer issues and remove barriers. 
 Manage the full-year forecast in Salesforce and Clari and implement new ways to improve forecast accuracy.
